theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_pw_plane_map_volume
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → Euclid P) (w : Euclid P) (pL : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid n), Orthonormal ℝ v → (∀ (x : Euclid P) (i : Fin n), pL x i = inner ℝ (v i) x) → Measure.map pL ((μHE[n]).restrict {y : Euclid P | y - w ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range v)}) = (volume : Measure (Euclid n))
